change: Moved only the optional encoder and its two capacitors to bottom DNP. Rechecked filled A1 drain-to-shunt and four motor-output paths at 0.075/0.05 mm after the local signal reroute. All nine Kelvin/analog branches, power corridors and parallel thermal vias are preserved.

before.method: 9-point DC sheet-conductance screening; 35 um copper at 20 C, 20 um via plating, 1.6 mm equally spaced stack
limitations: Grid approximation; validate mesh convergence and native connectivity separately
Ideal terminal contacts; via contacts approximate, copper thickness and barrel plating are assumptions
Excludes connector/contact, shunt and transistor resistance, AC/PWM/proximity effects and temperature feedback
DC 5.5 A comparison is not a duty-cycle, temperature-rise or current-rating qualification
